findings.title: Missing envelope timestamps become false dropped assignments
findings.what: assignmentTimestampMs correctly falls back from the envelope timestamp to payload.timestamp, but dropped detection and age reporting instead call parseDateMs only on the envelope. A missing or invalid envelope timestamp becomes 0, so any unread assignment is reported as ancient, dropped, and potentially stalled even when its valid payload timestamp is inside the grace window.
findings.fix: Use assignmentTimestampMs consistently for dropped filtering and age calculation, and exclude assignments whose effective timestamp is null instead of assigning epoch age.
findings.acceptance: Add fixtures with an empty envelope timestamp and a recent payload.timestamp, plus invalid timestamps in both locations; the former must respect the grace window and the latter must not appear in droppedAssignments or stalledAgents.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the fallback at src/lib/parse-teams.ts:182-185 is used for team bounds but bypassed at lines 325 and 336; the shared parser returns 0 for absent or invalid dates, making the false classification reproducible.

findings.title: Non-failure telemetry events dilute reliability metrics
findings.what: parseTelemetryLine requires only a nonempty event_name, parseTelemetryDir appends every such event, and analyzeReliability counts the entire array. Because these files also contain tengu_exit, retry, MCP, and other events, unrelated records default to attempt 1 and elapsed_ms 0, increasing totalEvents and lowering retryStormPct despite not being slow-first-byte failures.
findings.fix: Restrict the reliability parse path to event_name === 'tengu_api_slow_first_byte' before emitting TelemetryEvent records, or defensively filter to that event inside analyzeReliability while leaving the separate tengu_exit latency parser unchanged.
findings.acceptance: Create a telemetry artifact containing one attempt-4 tengu_api_slow_first_byte event and one tengu_exit event; parseTelemetryDir plus analyzeReliability must report totalEvents=1, totalStormEvents=1, and retryStormPct=100, while parseTelemetryLatencyDir still captures the tengu_exit sample.
findings.verifyNote: The second pass re-read the parser, directory collector, analyzer, and existing tests. No event-name filter exists in the reliability path, and tests exercise only slow-first-byte reliability fixtures, so the mixed-event dilution remains reproducible at the audited baseline.
